notes.text: In Act 1, we discovered how generalization / base class works. Several different things can share the same core traits. When they do, we group them under one shared label. In Python, that label becomes a class, the foundation every member builds on.

In Act 2, we discovered how child class / is-a relationship works. A child keeps every trait of the shared group automatically. Then it adds its own special ability on top. In Python, class Eagle(Animal): says “Eagle IS-A Animal”.
